name: Draw A Raft & Set Sail
desc:
Draw your raft, and sail across the ocean to the ENDZONE! 🌊

How To Play:
✏️ Draw your raft!
🚤 Spawn it in the ocean!
🌊🏁 Ride the waves across to the endzone!

Every creation floats differently - light rafts bounce, heavy rafts stay stable. What will you build?

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE for updates + join the group!
